import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long BIG_INF = 17446744073709551616L;
    static long M, nVal, kVal;
    static long[][] dpArr = new long[19][300005];
    static long[] fact = new long[300005], invFact = new long[300005];

    static long power(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1L;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1L) == 1L) res = (res * base) % M;
            base = (base * base) % M;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long nChoose(int a, int b) {
        return (((fact[a] * invFact[b]) % M) * invFact[a - b]) % M;
    }

    static long computeResult() {
        int i, j, mask;
        fact[0] = 1L;
        long limit = Math.max(nVal, kVal);
        for (i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % M;
        }
        invFact[(int)limit] = power(fact[(int)limit], M - 2);
        for (i = (int)limit - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = (invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % M;
        }
        for (i = 1; i <= nVal; i++) {
            dpArr[1][i] = invFact[i];
        }
        long totalAns = (dpArr[1][(int)nVal] * nChoose((int)kVal, 1)) % M;
        int maxIter = (int)Math.min(18, kVal);
        for (i = 2; i <= maxIter; i++) {
            for (j = (int)nVal; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)nVal) {
                if (dpArr[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;
                int rem = (int)(nVal ^ j);
                for (mask = rem; mask > j; mask = (mask - 1) & rem) {
                    dpArr[i][j ^ mask] += dpArr[i - 1][j] * invFact[mask];
                    if (dpArr[i][j ^ mask] > BIG_INF) dpArr[i][j ^ mask] %= M;
                }
            }
            for (j = (int)nVal; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)nVal) {
                if (dpArr[i][j] >= M) dpArr[i][j] %= M;
            }
            long resVal = (dpArr[i][(int)nVal] * nChoose(i, (int)kVal)) % M;
            resVal = (resVal * fact[i]) % M;
            totalAns = (totalAns + resVal >= M) ? totalAns + resVal - M : totalAns + resVal;
        }
        totalAns = (totalAns * fact[(int)nVal]) % M;
        return totalAns;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nVal = sc.nextLong();
        kVal = sc.nextLong();
        M = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = power(kVal, nVal);
        if (nVal % 2 == 0) ans = (ans - computeResult() + M) % M;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
